blocks: 1. No count anywhere in the modal reads higher than 20 - not the scope tab (for example 'Work Orders (20)'), not the group heading, and not the 'Show all N' link ('Show all 20').

3. The scoped tab shows at most 20 rows, scrolled inside the modal, with no pagination and no further loading.
